description: Configure an additional calculation mode. Calculation modes include creep, dynamic, fluid, imass, plugins, thermal, array, cfd, cluster, energy, feblock, highorder, hotetra, matrixflow, mechanical, axisymmetry. This command allows the user to specify that the model is using calculation modes that either require extra resources or are restricted by the current license. The model configure command can be given at any stage of an analysis, but it must be given before the calculation mode (model solve or model cycle) can be invoked.
notes: Must be given BEFORE model solve or model cycle can be invoked
Can be given at any stage of an analysis
Configures calculation modes that require extra resources or license restrictions
Once configured, the mode remains active for the model
May affect available memory and computational resources
ITASCA 9.1 and later use model configure fluid-flow for FLAC groundwater flow; 9.0 used model configure fluid.
The bundled FLAC command block omits common-page keywords for other Itasca products.

python_sdk_alternative.workaround: itasca.command('model configure fluid') - Python SDK does not provide a direct configure method
